# Findings

Every number on these pages is rendered from the evidence ledger, `docs/ledger/claims.public.json`,
by `strata ledger render`. Nothing here is typed by hand, and CI fails if a page drifts from the
ledger or gains a number that does not come from it (`strata ledger check`).

Only allow-listed claims computed on the real extract appear here: aggregates over enough clients
to publish, never an identifier and never a row. Every other finding stays in the private report.
Each number travels with its context: the number of clients behind it, the period, the source and
the fingerprint of the data it was computed from.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Channels and age](channels.md) | How clients split across channels; The digital divide by age |
| [The week](calendar.md) | The week of a retail bank |
| [Leading digits](amounts.md) | Leading digits of card purchases |

How the robustness verdicts are reached is explained in
[the robustness method](../methods/robustness.md).
